title: Complex Casework
description: This module prepares practitioners to work with high‑risk, multi‑layered, and complex DFV cases. It covers advanced risk factors, trauma complexity, and navigating challenging family dynamics while maintaining safety, clarity, and professional boundaries.
outcomes: Identify and respond to high‑risk and complex DFV presentations
Work effectively with clients experiencing multi‑layered trauma
Navigate complex family dynamics while maintaining safety and clarity
